ui_description: All non-text content must have a text alternative.
fix_tip: Ensure meaningful images, buttons, and controls have descriptive alt text or labels. Decorative images must have alt="".

ui_description: Audio-only and Video-only (Prerecorded) must have a text alternative (transcript/description).
fix_tip: Provide a link to a full text transcript below the media player.

ui_description: Captions are required for all prerecorded video with sound.
fix_tip: Include a synchronized caption file (SRT or VTT) with the media player.

ui_description: Audio Description or Media Alternative is provided for prerecorded video.
fix_tip: Embed a video version that includes an audio description track for visual-only actions.

ui_description: Live audio content must have real-time captions.
fix_tip: Use a real-time captioning service for all live streams.

ui_description: Prerecorded video must have audio description.
fix_tip: Ensure all significant visual information is conveyed either via dialogue or a separate audio description track.

ui_description: Sign Language (Prerecorded) is provided for all prerecorded audio content.
fix_tip: Provide a sign language interpretation for all prerecorded audio and video content.

ui_description: Extended Audio Description (Prerecorded) is provided when standard audio description is insufficient.
fix_tip: Pause the video when necessary to include an extended audio description that conveys all necessary visual information.

ui_description: Media Alternative (Prerecorded) is provided for all prerecorded video.
fix_tip: Provide a link to a full text transcript including all dialogue and visual information for the video.

ui_description: Audio-only (Live) has an alternative.
fix_tip: Provide a text-based alternative (e.g., live human transcription) for all live audio-only content.

ui_description: Information and relationships conveyed through visual presentation are programmatically determined.
fix_tip: Use proper semantic HTML: headings (h1-h6), lists (ul/ol), and tables (th/caption) instead of styling alone.

ui_description: Meaningful sequence is ensured when the sequence affects meaning.
fix_tip: Verify the source code order matches the logical reading order. Use CSS flex/grid responsibly.

ui_description: Do not rely on sight alone (shape, size, or color) for instructions.
fix_tip: Always include text labels or icons along with color or positional cues.

ui_description: Content must adapt to device orientation (portrait/landscape).
fix_tip: Avoid CSS or device-level settings that lock the screen orientation.

ui_description: Identify input purpose. (Fields should use the 'autocomplete' attribute).
fix_tip: Use the 'autocomplete' attribute on form fields where appropriate to specify the meaning.

ui_description: Identify Purpose: The purpose of UI components, icons, and regions can be programmatically determined.
fix_tip: Use appropriate ARIA roles and landmarks (e.g., role='search', role='main') to identify the purpose of regions and components.

ui_description: Color alone is not used to convey information or distinguish a visual element.
fix_tip: Ensure links or form errors are marked with text, icons, or underline, not just a color change.

ui_description: Audio content does not play automatically for more than 3 seconds.
fix_tip: Any auto-playing audio must be user-controlled or less than 3 seconds long.

ui_description: Text contrast must meet a minimum ratio of 4.5:1.
fix_tip: Increase the contrast ratio of text and background colors (or 3:1 for large text).

ui_description: Text can be resized without loss of content or functionality up to 200%.
fix_tip: Avoid fixed font units (like 'px') and ensure content is not clipped when zoomed.

ui_description: Images of text are only used for purely decorative purposes.
fix_tip: Replace images of text with actual HTML text and CSS styling.

ui_description: Contrast (Enhanced): Text contrast must meet a ratio of 7:1.
fix_tip: Achieve a minimum contrast ratio of 7:1 (or 4.5:1 for large text) for all essential text content.

ui_description: Low or No Background Audio: Audio content with speech has no or very low background noise.
fix_tip: Ensure the background music or noise is at least 20dB lower than the foreground speech content.

ui_description: Visual Presentation: Text blocks are easily readable with user-selectable styling and spacing.
fix_tip: Do not fully justify text, use appropriate line height (at least 1.5), and ensure text blocks are not too wide.

ui_description: Images of Text (No Exception): Images of text are only used for decoration.
fix_tip: The use of images of text is prohibited except for decorative purposes.

ui_description: Reflow: Content must adapt to a single column when zoomed.
fix_tip: Test the page at 400% zoom (1280px wide content) on a maximized browser window. No horizontal scrolling.

ui_description: Non-text content (icons, buttons, graphs) must have contrast ratio of at least 3:1.
fix_tip: Increase the contrast ratio of critical interface elements (e.g., icons, disabled states, chart lines).

ui_description: Text Spacing: No loss of content when line height, letter, word, or paragraph spacing is adjusted.
fix_tip: Ensure content doesn't overlap or become unreadable when text spacing settings are applied.

ui_description: Content on Hover or Focus: Dismissable and Persistent.
fix_tip: Ensure tooltips and popovers can be easily dismissed, do not disappear when moving the mouse, and are accessible by keyboard.

ui_description: All functionality must be operable via keyboard.
fix_tip: Manually navigate the entire site using only the Tab, Enter, and Space keys. Ensure all controls are reachable.

ui_description: No Keyboard Trap: Focus must not be trapped in one area.
fix_tip: Ensure the user can easily tab out of all interactive components (e.g., modals, carousels).

ui_description: Keyboard (No Exception): All functionality is operable through a keyboard without time limits.
fix_tip: Ensure no exceptions are made; all actions must be executable via the keyboard.

ui_description: Character Key Shortcuts: User can disable or modify single-key shortcuts.
fix_tip: Avoid using single letter keys as keyboard shortcuts unless the user is focused on an input field.

ui_description: Timing Adjustable: Time limits can be adjusted, extended, or turned off.
fix_tip: Ensure the user is alerted before a session times out and can easily extend the time limit.

ui_description: Pause, Stop, Hide: Moving, blinking, scrolling, or auto-updating content can be stopped.
fix_tip: Provide a mechanism to pause or stop all auto-moving content (carousels, animations).

ui_description: No Timing: Timing is not an essential part of the event or activity.
fix_tip: Avoid imposing any time limits on users for reading or interacting with content.

ui_description: Interruptions: Interruptions can be postponed or suppressed by the user.
fix_tip: Allow users to postpone or suppress non-essential and non-emergency interruptions (e.g., update alerts).

ui_description: Re-authenticating: If a session expires, the user can re-authenticate without losing data.
fix_tip: Ensure data entered before re-authentication is preserved after a successful login.

ui_description: Timeouts: Users are warned of any timeout that could result in data loss.
fix_tip: Provide a warning before any timeout, allowing the user to request more time or preserve data.

ui_description: Three Flashes or Below Threshold: No content flashes more than three times in any one-second period.
fix_tip: Avoid rapid flashing animations, especially red ones, to prevent seizures.

ui_description: Three Flashes: No content flashes more than three times per second.
fix_tip: Ensure all flashing content, including small areas, adheres to the maximum flash rate.

ui_description: Animation from Interactions: Motion animation can be disabled.
fix_tip: Provide a mechanism (e.g., a setting or a CSS media query) to disable non-essential animations.

ui_description: Bypass Blocks: A mechanism is available to bypass blocks of content (e.g., Skip to Main Content).
fix_tip: Implement a keyboard-accessible 'Skip to Main Content' link visible on focus.

ui_description: Page Titled: Web pages have descriptive titles.
fix_tip: Add a descriptive and concise <title> element to the document's <head>.

ui_description: Focus Order: The focus order must preserve meaning and operability.
fix_tip: Ensure the tabbing order is logical and intuitive (usually matching visual order).

ui_description: Link Purpose (In Context): The purpose of each link can be determined from the link text alone.
fix_tip: Avoid generic link text like 'Click Here.' Provide context within the <a> tag or its surrounding text.

ui_description: Multiple Ways: Provide multiple ways to locate a web page within a set of web pages.
fix_tip: Include at least two navigation options: site map, search, breadcrumbs, or primary navigation.

ui_description: Headings and Labels: Headings and labels describe topic or purpose.
fix_tip: Ensure all headings and form labels are clear, concise, and accurately describe the content below/field next to them.

ui_description: Focus Visible: Any user interface component that receives keyboard focus must have a visible focus indicator.
fix_tip: Ensure the default focus ring is not removed or obscured by CSS. Custom focus styles must meet 3:1 contrast.

ui_description: Location: Information about the user's location within a set of web pages is provided.
fix_tip: Use breadcrumbs, a site map, or a clear heading structure to indicate the current page's location.

ui_description: Link Purpose (Link Only): The purpose of each link can be determined from the link text alone.
fix_tip: Ensure the link text is fully descriptive without needing surrounding context (stricter than 2.4.4).

ui_description: Section Headings: Content is organized using section headings.
fix_tip: Ensure all major sections of content are properly introduced by a heading element (h1-h6).

ui_description: **Focus Not Obscured (Minimum):** Focus indicator is at least partially visible when focused.
fix_tip: Ensure sticky headers, footers, or overlays do not completely hide the keyboard focus indicator.

ui_description: **Focus Not Obscured (Enhanced):** Focus indicator is completely visible when focused.
fix_tip: Ensure sticky headers, footers, or overlays do not hide *any* portion of the keyboard focus indicator.

ui_description: **Focus Appearance (Enhanced):** The focus indicator is clearly visible and meets minimum size and contrast requirements.
fix_tip: The focus indicator must be a minimum size and have a 3:1 contrast ratio against the unfocused state.

ui_description: Pointer Gestures: Functionality that uses multipoint or path-based gestures can be operated with a single pointer.
fix_tip: Provide a button or control for complex gestures (e.g., zoom/pinch, swipe) that a single click can activate.

ui_description: Pointer Cancellation: The down-event of a pointer gesture does not initiate any function.
fix_tip: Ensure functionality is completed on the 'up' event (release) of the pointer, not the 'down' event (press).

ui_description: Label in Name: The accessible name of a component contains the text presented visually.
fix_tip: Ensure the text visible on a button (e.g., 'Submit') is included in its accessible name/label.

ui_description: Motion Actuation: Functionality that relies on device motion (shaking) has a UI-based alternative.
fix_tip: Provide a standard button or control to trigger the same action as the motion gesture.

ui_description: Target Size: Target size for touch/mouse must be at least 44x44 CSS pixels.
fix_tip: Ensure interactive targets (buttons, links) are large enough to be easily activated.

ui_description: Concurrent Input Mechanisms: Content does not restrict the input method.
fix_tip: Allow users to switch between mouse, keyboard, or speech input without system restrictions.

ui_description: **Dragging Movements:** All dragging movements can be operated by a single pointer without dragging.
fix_tip: Provide an alternative to drag-and-drop actions, such as buttons to move items or selecting start/end points.

ui_description: **Target Size (Minimum):** Target size must be at least 24x24 CSS pixels.
fix_tip: Ensure small interactive targets are at least 24x24 pixels, with specified exceptions (e.g., text links in a sentence).

ui_description: Language of Page: The default human language of the page is identified.
fix_tip: Set the correct language using the 'lang' attribute on the <html> element (e.g., <html lang='en'>).

ui_description: Language of Parts: The human language of any part of the content is identified.
fix_tip: Use the 'lang' attribute on individual elements (e.g., <span lang='fr'>) when the text differs from the page language.

ui_description: Unusual Words: Definitions are provided for unusual words, idioms, and jargon.
fix_tip: Include links to definitions or glossary entries for complex or context-specific words.

ui_description: Abbreviations: The expanded form of abbreviations is provided.
fix_tip: Use the `<abbr>` element with a `title` attribute, or define abbreviations the first time they are used.

ui_description: Reading Level: Content requires no more than a lower secondary education level to read.
fix_tip: Use simpler language, short sentences, and common words where possible.

ui_description: Pronunciation: A mechanism is available to indicate the correct pronunciation of words.
fix_tip: Provide an audio file or phonetic notation for words whose meaning changes with pronunciation.

ui_description: On Focus: Changing the state of a user interface component does not automatically cause a change of context.
fix_tip: Tabbing to an element should not automatically submit a form or navigate to a new page.

ui_description: On Input: Changing the setting of a user interface component does not automatically cause a change of context.
fix_tip: Selecting a radio button or checkbox should not automatically submit a form or navigate to a new page.

ui_description: Consistent Navigation: Navigational mechanisms that are repeated appear in the same relative order.
fix_tip: Ensure the order of primary navigation links remains consistent across all pages.

ui_description: Consistent Identification: Components with the same functionality are consistently identified.
fix_tip: If an icon is used as a 'Shopping Cart' on one page, it must look like a shopping cart on all pages.

ui_description: Change on Request: Changes of context are only initiated by user request or an option to turn them off.
fix_tip: Prevent automatic pop-ups, refreshes, or navigation unless the user explicitly requested the change.

ui_description: **Consistent Help:** Help mechanisms are provided consistently across a set of web pages.
fix_tip: If a help link, chatbot, or contact info is provided, ensure its relative position and identification are the same on every page.

ui_description: Error Identification: Input errors are automatically detected and described to the user.
fix_tip: Use ARIA attributes and native form validation to alert users to errors in a clear, accessible manner.

ui_description: Labels or Instructions: Labels or instructions are provided for all form input fields.
fix_tip: Ensure every input field has a corresponding <label> element properly associated using 'for' and 'id' attributes.

ui_description: Error Suggestion: Suggestions for correcting the input error are provided automatically.
fix_tip: If an input error is detected, provide concrete, accessible suggestions for correction (e.g., 'Did you mean to enter mm/dd/yyyy?').

ui_description: Error Prevention (Legal, Financial, Data): Users can review, correct, or reverse submissions.
fix_tip: Provide a confirmation page or an 'undo' button for submissions involving critical data.

ui_description: Help: Context-sensitive help is available.
fix_tip: Provide clear instructions or help links specific to the task/field the user is currently interacting with.

ui_description: Error Prevention (All): Users can review, correct, or reverse submissions for all forms.
fix_tip: Apply error prevention (review, confirm, or reverse) to ALL forms, not just those with legal/financial data.

ui_description: **Redundant Entry:** Automatically populate information available in a previous step.
fix_tip: Avoid forcing users to enter the same information twice in one session, where possible, using auto-population or selection.

ui_description: **Accessible Authentication (Minimum):** No cognitive function tests (like memorizing patterns) for authentication.
fix_tip: Provide a non-cognitive alternative for authentication (e.g., copy-pasteable password, email link, biometrics).

ui_description: **Accessible Authentication (Enhanced):** Authentication does not rely on object recognition or memorization tests.
fix_tip: Authentication should rely on non-text content recognition or stored personal content, or provide an even simpler alternative than the minimum (3.3.8).

ui_description: Parsing: Markup is valid with complete tags, no duplicate attributes, and unique IDs.
fix_tip: Ensure the HTML is well-formed. Use a validator tool to check for common parsing errors (Note: This SC is technically deprecated but kept for backwards compatibility in many implementations).

ui_description: Name, Role, Value: For all user interface components, the name and role can be programmatically determined.
fix_tip: Use native HTML elements (buttons, inputs) or correct ARIA attributes for custom controls.

ui_description: Status Messages: Status messages (e.g., success/error alerts) can be programmatically determined.
fix_tip: Use ARIA live regions (aria-live='polite') to announce dynamic content changes to screen reader users without shifting focus.
